# Draft:Timeline of the Pac-12 Conference

The Pac-12 was founded in 1915 as the Pacific Coast Conference with 4 founding members
{| class="wikitable"
|+1915 to 1916 PCC Teams
|California Golden Bears
|Washington Huskies
|-
|Oregon State Beavers
|Oregon Ducks
|}
In 1917, Independent Washington State joined.
{| class="wikitable"
|+1917 PCC Teams
|California Golden Bears
|Washington Huskies
|Oregon Ducks
|Oregon State Beavers
|Washington State Cougars
|}
In 1918, Independent Stanford joined.
{| class="wikitable"
|+1918 to 1921 PCC Teams
|California Golden Bears
|Washington Huskies
|Oregon Ducks
|-
|Oregon State Beavers
|Washington State Cougars
|Stanford Cardinal
|}
In 1922, Independent USC and Independent Idaho joined.
{| class="wikitable"
|+1922 to 1923 PCC Teams
|California Golden Bears
|Washington Huskies
|Oregon Ducks
|Oregon State Beavers
|-
|Washington State Cougars
|Stanford Cardinal
|USC Trojans
|Idaho Vandals
|}
In 1924, Independent Montana joined
{| class="wikitable"
|+1924 to 1927 PCC Teams
|California Golden Bears
|Washington Huskies
|Oregon Ducks
|-
|Oregon State Beavers
|Washington State Cougars
|Stanford Cardinal
|-
|USC Trojans
|Idaho Vandals
|Montana Grizzlies
|}
In 1928, UCLA joined from the Southern California Intercollegiate Athletic Conference
{| class="wikitable"
|+1928 to 1950 PCC Teams
|California Golden Bears
|Washington Huskies
|Oregon Ducks
|Oregon State Beavers
|Washington State Cougars
|-
|Stanford Cardinal
|USC Trojans
|Idaho Vandals
|Montana Grizzlies
|UCLA Bruins
|}
In 1950, Montana withdrew as an Independent team.
{| class="wikitable"
|+1950 to 1958 PCC Teams
|California Golden Bears
|Washington Huskies
|Oregon Ducks
|-
|Oregon State Beavers
|Washington State Cougars
|Stanford Cardinal
|-
|USC Trojans
|Idaho Vandals
|UCLA Bruins
|}
In 1959, the PCC disbanded following the pay-to-play scandals, Oregon, Oregon State, Washington State, and Idaho withdrew as Independent teams. The PCC was replaced by the Athletic Association of Western Universities
{| class="wikitable"
|+1959 to 1961 AAWU Teams
|California Golden Bears
|Washington Huskies
|UCLA Bruins
|-
|Stanford Cardinal
|USC Trojans
|
|}
In 1962, Washington State rejoined.
{| class="wikitable"
|+1962 to 1963 AAWU Teams
|California Golden Bears
|Washington Huskies
|Washington State Cougars
|-
|Stanford Cardinal
|USC Trojans
|UCLA Bruins
|}
In 1964, Oregon State and Oregon rejoined, the conference also rebranded as the Pacific-8 Conference or Pac-8
{| class="wikitable"
|+1964 to 1977 Pac-8 Teams
|California Golden Bears
|Washington Huskies
|Oregon Ducks
|Oregon State Beavers
|-
|Washington State Cougars
|Stanford Cardinal
|USC Trojans
|UCLA Bruins
|}
In 1978, Arizona and Arizona State joined from the Western Athletic Conference, the conference also rebranded as the Pacific-10 Conference or Pac-10.
{| class="wikitable"
|+1978 to 2010 Pac-10 Teams
|California Golden Bears
|Washington Huskies
|Oregon Ducks
|Oregon State Beavers
|Washington State Cougars
|-
|Stanford Cardinal
|USC Trojans
|UCLA Bruins
|Arizona Wildcats
|Arizona State Sun Devils
|}
In 2011, Colorado joined from the Big 12, Utah joined from the Mountain West, the conference also rebranded as the Pacific-12 Conference or Pac-12,
{| class="wikitable"
|+2011 to 2023 Pac-12 Teams
|California Golden Bears
|Washington Huskies
|Oregon Ducks
|Oregon State Beavers
|-
|Washington State Cougars
|Stanford Cardinal
|USC Trojans
|UCLA Bruins
|-
|Arizona Wildcats
|Arizona State Sun Devils
|Colorado Buffaloes
|Utah Utes
|}
In 2024, Colorado returned to the Big 12, Utah, Arizona and Arizona State moved to the Big 12, California and Stanford moved to the ACC, and Oregon, Washington, USC and UCLA moved to the Big Ten
{| class="wikitable"
|+2024 to present Pac-12 Teams
|Oregon State Beavers
|Washington State Cougars
|}
On July 1, 2026, Boise State, Colorado State, Fresno State, San Diego State, and Utah State will join from the Mountain West, and Gonzaga will join from the West Coast Conference
{| class="wikitable"
|+2026 to future Pac-12 Teams
|Oregon State Beavers
|Washington State Cougars

|Colorado State Rams
|-
|Fresno State Bulldogs
|Gonzaga Bulldogs
|San Diego State Aztecs
|Utah State Aggies
|}
